title: DarkHole: 2
summary: Hard-rated VulnHub box: exposed .git, SQL injection, a cron web shell and sudo to root.

card.caption: Rooted in about three hours; 34-page write-up.

did: An exposed `/.git/` directory let me rebuild the app’s source offline and find a UNION-based SQL injection.
The injection yielded SSH credentials. A local web shell in a cron task gave lateral movement to another user, and a sudo rule on Python 3 gave root.
results: An open /.git/ directory allowed offline source reconstruction, which exposed the SQL injection.
next: Block dot-files at the web server, use parameterized queries and audit sudo rules on interpreters.

signal: web access log: GET /.git/HEAD 200, then UNION SELECT in the query string

artifact.code:
# Web Access Log Anomaly:
GET /.git/HEAD HTTP/1.1 200
GET /login.php?id=-1' UNION SELECT 1,user,pass FROM users-- 200
# Sudo Abuse: sudo python3 -c 'import os; os.system("/bin/sh")'
